svg.aria-label: The cover of GPU-Accelerated Kubernetes. At night in a harbour, a raccoon in a dark blue cape stands at a ship's wheel on the deck of a container ship, its whistle in one paw. The containers are stacked in rows, and each glows with a green GPU chip. A stork on the top row holds a bundle marked 1 GPU, a hound on the dock listens to a server with a stethoscope, and 5 parrots sit on a ring-shaped perch on the mast, with arrows showing a value passed round the ring.
